mn100:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ.
mn100:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Dhānañjānī nāma brāhmaṇī Caṇḍalakappe paṭivasati abhippasannā Buddhe ca dhamme ca saṃghe ca.
mn100:2.2: Atha kho Dhānañjānī brāhmaṇī upakkhalitvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
mn100:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena Saṅgāravo nāma māṇavo Caṇḍalakappe paṭivasati tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhadānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
mn100:3.2: Assosi kho Saṅgāravo māṇavo Dhānañjāniyā brāhmaṇiyā evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānāya,
mn100:3.3: sutvā Dhānañjāniṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etad avoca: Avabhūtā
mn100:3.4: ca 'yaṃ Dhānañjāni brāhmaṇī parābhūtā ca 'yaṃ Dhānañjānī brāhmaṇī vijjamānānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ, atha ca pana tassa muṇḍakassa samaṇakassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti.
mn100:3.5: Na hi pana tvaṃ, tāta Bhadramukha, tassa Bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jānāsi;
mn100:3.6: sace tvaṃ, tāta Bhadramukha, tassa Bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jāneyyāsi, na tvaṃ, tāta Bhadramukha, taṃ Bhagavantaṃ akkositabbaṃ paribhāsitabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
mn100:3.7: Tena hi, bhoti, yadā samaṇo Gotamo Caṇḍalakappaṃ anuppatto hoti, atha kho me āroceyyāsīti.
mn100:3.8: Evaṃ Bhadramukhāti kho Dhānañjānī brāhmaṇī Saṅgāravassa māṇavassa paccassosi.
mn100:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Kosalesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno Caṇḍalakappaṃ tad avasari.
mn100:4.2: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Caṇḍalakappe viharati Todeyyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ambavane.
mn100:5.1: Assosi kho Dhānañjānī brāhmaṇī: Bhagavā kira Caṇḍalakappaṃ anuppatto Caṇḍalakappe viharati Todeyyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ambavane ti.
mn100:5.2: Atha kho Dhānañjānī brāhmaṇī yena Saṅgāravo māṇavo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Saṅgāravaṃ māṇavaṃ etad avoca:
mn100:5.3: Ayaṃ, tāta Bhadramukha, so Bhagavā Caṇḍalakappaṃ anuppatto Caṇḍalakappe viharati Todeyyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ambavane.
mn100:5.4: Yassa dāni tvaṃ, tāta Bhadramukha, kālaṃ maññasīti.
mn100:5.5: Evaṃ bhotīti kho Saṅgāravo māṇavo Dhānañjāniyā brāhmaṇiya paṭisutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn100:5.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Saṅgāravo māṇavo Bhagavantaṃ etad
mn100:6.1: avoca:-Santi kho, bho Gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.
mn100:6.2: Tatra, bho Gotama, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, tesaṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo katamo ti?
mn100:7.1: Diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattānaṃ ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānantānam pi kho ahaṃ, Bhāradvāja, vemattataṃ vadāmi.
mn100:7.5: Santi pana, Bhāradvāja, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti,
mn100:7.7: Santi, Bhāradvāja, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ yeva dhammaṃ abhiññāya, diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.
mn100:7.8: Tatra, Bhāradvāja, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ yeva dhammaṃ abhiññāya, diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, tesāham asmi. Tad aminā p'
mn100:8.1: etaṃ, Bhāradvāja pariyāyena veditabbaṃ. Yathā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ yeva dhammaṃ abhiññāya diṭṭhadhammābhiññavosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, tesāham asmi.
mn100:9.1: Idha me, Bhāradvāja, pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa Bodhisattass' eva sato etad ahosi:--
mn100:9.3: Nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn100:9.4: Yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan ti.
mn100:9.5: So kho ahaṃ, Bhāradvāja, aparena samayena daharo va samāno susu kālakeso . . .

mn100:31-33.1: So kho ahaṃ, Bhāradvāja, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā balaṃ gahetvā vivicc' eva kāmehi --pe-- paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.

mn100:42.1: Evaṃ vutte Saṅgāravo māṇavo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: -- Aṭṭhita
mn100:42.2: vata bhoto Gotamassa padhānaṃ ahosi, sappurisa vata bhoto Gotamassa padhānaṃ ahosi,
mn100:42.4: Kin nu kho, bho Gotama, atthi devā ti?
mn100:42.5: Ṭhānaso me taṃ, Bhāradvāja, viditaṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:42.7: ti. Kin nu kho, bho Gotama, atthi devā ti puṭṭho samāno, ṭhānaso me taṃ, Bhāradvāja, viditaṃ yadidaṃ atthi devā ti vadesi?
mn100:42.8: Nanu, bho Gotama, evaṃ sante tucchā musā hotīti?
mn100:42.9: Atthi devā ti, Bhāradvāja, puṭṭho samāno, atthi devā ti yo vadeyya , ṭhānaso viditā me viditā ti yo vadeyya,
mn100:42.10: atha khvettha viññūpurisena ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantabbaṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:42.12: Kissa pana me bhavaṃ Gotamo ādiken' eva na byākāsīti?
mn100:42.13: Ucce sammataṃ kho etaṃ, Bhāradvāja, lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:43.1: Evaṃ vutte Saṅgāravo māṇavo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: --
mn100:43.2: Abhikkantaṃ, bho Gotama; abhikkantam, bho Gotama,
mn100:43.3: Seyyathāpi, bho Gotama, nikujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya. andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: Cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, -- evam evaṃ bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn100:43.4: Esāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca.
mn100:43.5: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇagatan
